# Alexandria v0.0.31

# New

### Inventory
* Item rows now show a loading spinner while the AH price is being fetched and a faint dash when an item has no recent sale..
* AH price displays now fall back to a connected character's home server when no server is set instead of just showing blank.

### Alerts
* Added a new "Alerts" section under Pool, where you can add items to watch for and play a sound when they are in the pool.

### Tagging
* Added an Import/Export feature for tags, which allows sharing tags with other users.
* Tag routing can now send items to wardrobes.

### Auto-Lot
* Added the ability to define a limit to how many items a character should auto-lot on an item. The character will then auto-lot on the item until they reach the specified amount of that item in their inventory.

### Currency & Key Items
* Added Deselect/Select All functions to the character pickers in both views.

### Sparks / Unity Conversion
* Reworked to be more reliable. It should now properly detect and keep track of currency values in real-time and reasonably retry if an operation failed mid-conversion.

### Consolidate
* Each trade round is now capped to the collector's free slots and sends the smallest stacks first so a nearly-full receiver merges them away instead of over-trading past a full inventory.

### Augmentation
* Start / Roll buttons are now properly disabled while a run is already in progress.

# Bugfixes
* Fixed an issue where inventory and key-item snapshots would not update properly in some scenarios.
